summary: Pull with one or two Lightning Bolts while the creature closes, then melee once it reaches the character, until it dies.
source: owner, live demo 23 Sept 2026 (buff, one or two bolts while it closes, melee on contact)

summary: Walk in and melee until the creature dies: no mana spent, so mana is kept for healing and the next pull.
source: owner, live demo 23 Sept 2026 (often pulled at 10-30% mana; melee does most of the damage)

summary: Cast Lightning Bolt until the creature dies, from range: for a weak or slow creature that dies before it reaches the character.
source: live M3 fights 23 Sept 2026 (bolts took about a third of a level-1 creature each)

summary: Walk in and melee, cast the instant shock once, then melee until the creature dies: an instant spell is not pushed back by its hits.
source: levelling guides for Enhancement (knowledge/conflicts.md, Lightning Bolt in melee): no hard-cast bolt in the melee phase

summary: Pull with Lightning Bolt, cast the instant shock once the creature reaches the character, then melee until it dies.
source: author's composition of the owner's pull and the guides' shock, 25 Sept 2026; not yet seen live
